newsitem.title: USA: FGIC says Q3 net income rose 9.2 pct to $43.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: FGIC says Q3 net income rose 9.2 pct to $43.8 mln.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co, a unit of GE Capital Services, said its third quarter net income rose 9.2 percent to $43.8 million, compared to $40.1 million in the same period last year.

"By focusing on the municipal market's lower risk sectors where we have confidence providing our 30-year irrevocable guaranty, FGIC continues to succeed with its strategy of building the highest quality risk portfolio in the business," Ann Stern, FGIC's chairman, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
Stern said third quarter results were driven in part by a 40 percent drop in expenses and a $1.7 billion increase non-municipal home equity business.
Year-to-date net income was $136.2 million on revenues of $195.4 million, compared to net income of $132 million on revenues of $132 million $190.4 million for the same period in 1995.
Core net income, which excludes earning from bond refundings, capital gains and other adjustments, was $40.1 million for the third quarter, compared to $39.5 million for third quarter 1995.
GE Capital Services is a sholly-owned subsidiary of General Electric Co.
